question: Identify the antonym of "Morbid"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Cheerful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Morbid"** refers to something that is unhealthy, gloomy, or related to unpleasant topics like death or disease. (अस्वस्थ, विकृत, उदासीन)
 
 
• **Example:** He had a morbid fascination with horror movies and crime documentaries.
 
 
• The word **"Cheerful"**, on the other hand, means being noticeably happy and optimistic, which is the direct opposite of "morbid." (प्रसन्न, हर्षित)
 
 
• **Example:** She greeted everyone with a cheerful smile that brightened up their day.
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"Morbid"** is **"Cheerful."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Cheerful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Grim** (गंभीर, सख्त): Something that is serious, harsh, or depressing in nature.
 
 
• **Example:** The situation looked grim after the storm destroyed most of the town.
 
 

 
• **Gloomy** (उदास, अंधकारमय): Refers to something that is dark, depressing, or lacking in cheerfulness.
 
 
• **Example:** The rainy weather made the entire day feel gloomy and sad.
 
 

 
• **Sickly** (रोगी, कमजोर): Describes someone or something that appears weak, unhealthy, or prone to illness.
 
 
• **Example:** His sickly appearance worried his family and friends.
